name: Shaggy Ape 11
author: arghyaBiswasDev
description: Neon rounded sky-blue toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #fff to #007bff, border becomes 1px solid #007bff, transform becomes translateX(1.4em). On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #007bff.
